title: toxicoscordion gramineum
intro: Toxicoscordion gramineum, commonly known as Death Camas, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of western North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and pneumonia, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Death Camas include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds. However, it's essential to note that Death Camas is highly toxic and can be fatal if ingested, making it a plant to be handled with extreme caution.
